name: n5-canary-model-release-environment
description: Runtime for packaging, canary evaluation, and promotion of a model release.

tools.package_model_artifact: Packages the model artifact and records artifact_packaged.
tools.run_canary_evaluation: Runs canary evaluation after packaging and records canary_evaluated.
tools.promote_canary_model: Promotes the canary model after evaluation and records model_promoted.
